# Full Compile

The full compile feature processes an entire repository, collecting all necessary artifacts, analyzing them, and generating a comprehensive summary of the compile results. This allows users to capture all relevant data from the codebase in one go, enabling better insights into its structure and behavior.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.compile_full`
